content.short: Blockchair is a cross-blockchain search and analytics engine with an API to retrieve data and conduct full-text searches across blockchains.
content.description: Founded in 2016, Blockchair is a cross-blockchain search and analytics platform that supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many other networks. It enables users to explore data across chains by filtering and sorting blocks and transactions, providing a unified view of activity. Developers can access data through the Blockchair API to perform full-text searches across multiple blockchains and retrieve structured results. The platform also supports analytical queries such as filtering, sorting, and aggregating blockchain data to reveal trends and insights.
